title: Pre-stream checklist
summary: Everything ready before going live. Never trade readiness for an on-time start.
steps: T-30 to T-15: time tracker on. Review the strategy, stream workbook, last report and last feedback.
Confirm stream mode, opening push and pull, 3 scenes, 4 main + 2 backup goals, fillers and engagement account.
T-15: model joins and shares her screen. Run a live speed test on her device and an OBS check (scene, camera, preview, audio).
Check framing, lighting, background and privacy, and outfit. Give a short briefing.
T-2: final confirmation and announcement. Zoom cams and mics off, recording stopped for the live part.
tips: A short delay with a status and reason posted is fine. A silent late start is not.

title: Post-stream checklist
summary: Confirm offline everywhere, then lead a real recap conversation.
steps: Check the stream is offline on every platform, and OBS is stopped.
Post the offline update.
Lead the recap: her feedback first, then key results, 1–2 wins and the most useful improvement.
Write the report with verified numbers only, never estimates.
Hand off verified fan context to the chat team and flag blocked or muted users.

title: Fathom and Zoom rules
summary: Record the prep and the calls. Stop recording while live.
steps: Fathom ON for team prep and the pre-stream and post-stream calls.
Fathom stopped for the live portion.
Zoom cameras and mics off before going live.
Recordings are reviewed, so treat every call as on the record.

title: If tech fails
steps: Identify the problem (internet, OBS, camera, audio, power).
Try the quick fix: restart the source, switch to the backup connection or device.
Verify it works before going back live.
If it's not fixed in a few minutes, escalate to the tech team and your TL.
Post a status and reason so everyone knows what's happening, then write it up.
tips: Run tech checks before the shift. The same issue twice with no fix or backup is not accepted.

title: Escalation and Incident Flags
summary: Report it now, not at post-stream. One thread per stream day.
steps: Tell your TL right away.
Post a new 🚩 INCIDENT FLAG in the creator's operator channel: date/time, creator, operator, issue, action taken, status, assigned TL, screenshot.
Keep every update in that one thread. A separate incident gets a new flag.
When escalating, give: observation, evidence, impact, recommended action.
